svg.title: Siddhartha Peruri
svg.desc: The name SIDDHARTHA set in two rows, SIDDH over ARTHA, split at the A that SIDDHA and ARTHA share. Each of the five columns draws its two letters a different way: sketched by hand, inferred as a cloud of points, computed as a lattice of cells, arranged as exact construction geometry, and measured as solid strokes with dimension lines. An ember sits in the counter of the shared A.
